reviews.title: Issue with moving tabs
reviews.text:
There is a frustrating issue when trying to rearrange tabs. 
When I press and hold a tab for around two seconds to activate the moving function, I can drag it to where I want it. 
However, when I release the tab at the new position, it does not stay there. 
Instead, it annoyingly jumps back to its original position. 

This happens when trying to move a tab left, right, up or down. 
It makes rearranging tabs unnecessarily difficult and frustrating. 
Please fix this so that tabs reliably remain in the position where they are dropped. 
This would make tab management much smoother and more intuitive.

reviews.title: Absolute Disaster of an App — Wasted 2 Days, Lost Sleep, and Held My Storage Hostage!
reviews.text:
I am writing this review out of pure frustration after dealing with one of the most poorly engineered file management systems I have ever encountered in a mobile browser. If I could give this app zero stars, I would without a single second of hesitation.
I spent over TWO FULL DAYS anxiously waiting for a massive file to finish downloading, constantly checking my phone, losing sleep, and keeping my device connected just to make sure the process wasn't interrupted. The download finally reached the end, consuming a huge chunk of my device's physical storage, only for Aloha Browser to hit me with an "Expired Link" error and completely lock me out of my own file.
Here is the absolute mockery of this app's design: The entire file is physically sitting inside my iPhone's storage right now, yet Aloha’s completely brain-dead interface refuses to let me save, export, or play it!
Instead of offering a basic, logical feature—like letting users resume, edit the source URL, or simply extract the fully downloaded cached data—Aloha treats the file as non-existent and demands that I re-download the entire thing from scratch! Their "Update Link" prompt is an absolute joke that fails completely and just forces a duplicate download instead of linking to the existing cache.

reviews.title: Very disappointing

The only issue I had was the audio and video going out of sync no matter how many times you would pause it after a few seconds it would delay. Then from 2023 my downloads started freezing. Since then I’ve had to manually pause and resume downloads as they get stuck at 0mbs, it happens on any website (specifically for films) but it is an absolute nightmare as it can take up to 3 hours to download a 30 minute video even on 250mbs internet. I’ve tried everything on the app settings, contacted support, sat there for hours tapping the screen trying to download one video only for it to not work in the end. This is one of the most frustrating things as it should be simple. The fact that this has been mentioned in the website forums multiple times and it still hasn’t been sorted shows that negative feedback is being ignored. It’s a shame as it was a good app at first and it was worthy of 4-5 stars, when you can’t even use the one feature that makes the app useful then it’s absolutely useless having it installed.

reviews.title: Lies and Capped Download Limits
reviews.text: Was great until they introduced a download limit unless you pay for their dumb premium subscription. If it was a 1 time fee of like $10? Sure, the UI and features are worth it, but $9 A MONTH or $80 A YEAR? Just to download videos? Not a chance, download your content elsewhere and transfer it to Aloha, what they’re doing to try and force people to buy their unneeded subscription is predatory and scummy, not worthy of your business. They’re trying to push a narrative where their 1% of paid users are being banned because “too many people are downloading” which is a complete lie. This app detects publicly available media links (videos) and allows us to download them through the app, if sites were to ban anyone from using them, it would be the individual user, not the app… They’re just using this shoddy story as a way to justify the sudden restrictions they imposed with no warning. I loved this app for years, it was the best, but now it seems like it’s time for some competition.
